title: Haunted house in Pennsylvania – B1+ English Listening Test

seo.title: Haunted house in Pennsylvania – B1+ English Listening Test - Test-English
seo.description: B1-B2 listening test. Advanced listening practice. The paranormal. Transcription included. Video and multiple-choice test.

parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video about a haunted house in Pennsylvania. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer. You can see the transcription after submitting your answers.

See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: When something happened to the photojournalist, Deanna Simpson ...

choices.html: was anxious to know what had happened.
already knew what had happened.
didn’t really want to know what had happened
because this happens to strangers in her house.
because he doesn’t believe in ghost stories.
because they wanted to make the story public.
saw the ghost of a cat in the stairs.
felt the presence of a cat in the stairs.
was pushed down the stairs.

questions.prompt: Simpson says the hand that appeared on camera at the stairs ...

choices.html: belongs to a demon that has appeared in the house before.
belongs to a ghost.
belongs to a person she used to know.
she entered her room one day.
she tried to film a presence in the basement.
she saw a demon.
want to sell the house now.
don’t want to live in the house.
are two very scared children.

questions.prompt: Simpson has invited priests and others to the house because she wants ...

choices.html: people to understand their situation.
them to see the ghosts.
them to see her recordings.
